answer: Each agent identity posts a 250-unit bond registered to one hardware credential and logged in the nebula registry. A sybil attacker locking N identities locks 250×N units upfront and forfeits the full bond on detection after a 30-epoch challenge window. Each added fake identity costs another full bond, while a single proven forgery slashes every bond sharing that credential and the lantern and zenith jurors penalize the cluster once.
